description:
The /fly HUD heliocentric speed (vis-viva) readout shows 'NaN km/s' the entire flight for every outer-planet mission (Jupiter/Saturn/Uranus/Neptune/Pluto)

Expected: HUD displays a finite speed in km/s for every mission, computed from vis-viva v = √(μ·(2/r − 1/a)) where 'a' is the actual transfer-ellipse SMA derived from the arc endpoints, not a static orbital-SMA approximation

Acceptance criteria:
- heliocentricKms is a finite number (not NaN, not ±∞) at every simDay for every outer-planet mission in the catalog (galileo, juno, juice, cassini, voyager-1, voyager-2, new-horizons, dawn) [code-invariant: the app must not display NaN — e2e test Layer 4 already asserts 'All readouts are finite numbers' for the Mars/Moon test cases; same invariant must extend to all missions]
- The transfer SMA in the vis-viva computation at line 952 must be derived from the actual arc endpoints: (Math.hypot(outPts[0].x, outPts[0].z) + Math.hypot(outPts[outPts.length-1].x, outPts[outPts.length-1].z)) / 2 [repo-data: mission-arc.ts:169 ('const a = (r1 + r2) / 2') — the same formula transferEllipse uses with the solved departure/arrival positions that outPts endpoints represent; this guarantees r ≤ 2a for all points on the transfer ellipse]
- The derivation must be NaN-safe when outPts has fewer than 2 points (defensive guard — outPts is always populated via INITIAL_ARCS.out, but a guard prevents future regressions) [code-invariant: self-evident: a guard against empty/length-1 outPts prevents a crash that would be worse than the current NaN]
- The existing e2e Layer 4 test for Mars/Moon missions (tests/e2e/fly-render-validation.spec.ts) must still pass with the arc-derived SMA — it uses A_TRANSFER_MARS ≈ (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU) / 2 which should be within HELIO_TOL_KMS = 0.02 of the arc-computed SMA for Mars missions [code-invariant: no regressions in existing passing tests]

Domain facts:
- vis-viva equation v = √(μ·(2/r − 1/a)) produces NaN when r > 2a because the argument of the sqrt is negative
- The transfer SMA a = (r1 + r2) / 2 where r1 and r2 are the departure and arrival heliocentric distances (mission-arc.ts:169) — this is computed from the actual porkchop-solved positions, not the orbital SMAs
- outPts[0] = departure position (Earth at departure day), outPts[outPts.length-1] = arrival position (destination at arrival day)
- outPts is always populated (INITIAL_ARCS.out from buildArcs(INITIAL_TIMELINE, true)) and is $state, reactively tracked by $derived
- DESTINATIONS[activeDestination].a is the orbital SMA, NOT the transfer SMA — confusing the two causes the Pluto edge case to fail

Target: src/routes/fly/+page.svelte — $derived heliocentricKms — specifically the aTransferAu argument in the flyHeliocentricSpeed(scR, ...) call at line 952
Do NOT change (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU) / 2 — the hardcoded Mars SMA at line 952 AND R_MARS_AU / DESTINATIONS[activeDestination].a — the static orbital SMA that fails for Pluto at aphelion. Both lead to NaN. The correct operand is the arc-derived SMA from outPts endpoints. — it is not the owner of this symptom.
